record.paper_title: Negative Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.original_question: Given a signed graph Σ, find a largest possible family of pairwise edge-disjoint negative circles in Σ.

evidence.quote: P5–8. The same as P1–4 but for edge-disjoint circles.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A signed graph $\Sigma = (G, \sigma)$ consists of a graph $G = (V, E)$ together with a sign function $\sigma : E \to \{+1, -1\}$. A circle (or cycle) in $\Sigma$ is a connected 2-regular subgraph; the sign of a circle $C$ is the product $\prod_{e \in E(C)} \sigma(e)$, and $C$ is called negative if this product equals $-1$. Two circles are edge-disjoint if they share no edge.

Develop a theory (structural results, exact formulas, sharp bounds, or efficient algorithms) determining, for an arbitrary signed graph $\Sigma$, the maximum cardinality
$$\nu^{-}_{e}(\Sigma) \;=\; \max\bigl\{\, |\mathcal{F}| \;:\; \mathcal{F} \text{ is a family of pairwise edge-disjoint negative circles in } \Sigma \,\bigr\}.$$
That is, characterize or compute the largest possible family of pairwise edge-disjoint negative circles in a signed graph.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of determining the maximum number of pairwise edge-disjoint negative circles in a signed graph remains open in general. Recent works (e.g., on packing signatures in signed graphs, packing numbers for antibalanced planar signed graphs of negative girth ≥ 5, and weakly-negative-circle packing vs. clustering) address special cases and related variants but do not resolve the general question.

status_evidence.title: Packing Signatures in Signed Graphs (SIAM J. Discrete Math.)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies packing of signatures (equivalent to edge-disjoint negative-edge sets) in signed graphs, addressing special classes.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial progress on packing-type problems in signed graphs; general edge-disjoint negative-circle packing remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On the packing number of antibalanced signed simple planar graphs of negative girth at least 5
status_evidence.snippet: Determines packing numbers in a restricted subclass of signed planar graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Only restricted subclasses are resolved; the general problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Weakly Negative Circles Versus Best Clustering in Signed Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Maximum number of edge-disjoint weakly negative circles relates to clustering bounds.
status_evidence.claim: The maximum edge-disjoint negative-circle packing number is studied as a bound but not generally determined.
